pages.title: Honey Badger
pages.text: The $(o)Honey Badger$() ($(o)Mellivora capensis$()), or ratel, is a stocky, short-legged mustelid of Africa, the Middle East and India.$(br2)It is renowned for its fearlessness, defending itself against animals many times its size with its sharp claws and its thick, loose skin, which is hard to bite through.$(br2)It eats almost anything, from insects and honey to snakes and small mammals, and has a striking silver-white mantle over a black body.
